complete_examples.text: In the third example, the influence of vehicle speed on VTS system vibrations is examined and in the last example, the effect of track bed support stiffness on system vibrations has been clarified.
It is known that the track bed support stiffness is an essential mechanical parameter in ballasted tracks, being determined by the grading and compactness of the ballast.
